'''Rebel Leader Packs''' is the 4th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in April 1996. It is a two-card Light Side premium: [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] and [[Red Leader In Red 1]].<ref name="enc32rl">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=33 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 33 (Promotional Packs, Rebel Leader Pack). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher handed the pack out at employee promotional appearances and mailed it on request from April 1996 through 31 January 1998.<ref name="enc20">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=24 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], p. 24 (Promotional Cards) and pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc32rl" />

''[[Scrye]]'' 4.2 (June 1997) packed one as a magazine insert.<ref name="enc20" /><ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
